items.title: Supertake raises $20M to let AI agents turn your market predictions into stock portfolios
items.summary: Think you know where the market is headed? A startup called Supertake lets you put money behind your ideas without having to pick the stocks yourself.
items.creator: Sarah Perez

items.title: Elon Musk and others rejoice as Jensen Huang is reinstated at Nvidia amid scandal
items.summary: "The mistake has been corrected," Elon Musk chimed in.
items.creator: Amanda Silberling

items.title: Megaspeed, the company at the center of the Jensen Huang scandal, appears headed for a US blacklist
items.summary: Megaspeed, which was previously led by Alice Huang, would be barred from doing business with U.S. companies unless those companies attained a special license from the federal government.
items.creator: Lucas Ropek
